$description: Platform UI design tokens. Primitive values feed semantic intent tokens. This file is the single authoritative source of every design-token value: the generator walks it, holds no values of its own, and the verifier fails on any emitted value that is not reachable from a $value here (design.md D-A, D-B).

200.$description: Dark-capable accent shade. Used by the dark theme for primary hover and the focus ring.

300.$description: Dark-capable accent shade. Used by the dark theme for primary.

700.$description: Success text role. Contrast audit (ui-design-guideline-adoption): 5.02:1 on the light surface, 4.58:1 on the muted chip — the second-tightest AA text margin in the kit; re-measure before changing the shade.
Warning text role. Contrast audit (ui-design-guideline-adoption): 5.02:1 on the light surface, 4.58:1 on the muted chip — the tightest AA text margin in the kit; re-measure before changing the shade.

focusRing.$description: Documented always-visible focus-indicator name (--color-focus-ring) adopted from the approved brand guideline. Declared as an alias of the semantic focus ring so it emits as var(--focus-ring) and follows every theme override without a second value: 6.41:1 on the light background, 12.56:1 on the dark background, against the 3:1 non-text floor of WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11. The legacy --focus-ring name stays the baselined base (emitted-baseline.json); this is the name consumer guidance cites.

sans.$description: Primary family adopted from the approved brand guideline (ui-design-guideline-adoption, D-1), system-ui fallback kept. Loading Outfit — self-hosted @font-face or next/font — is the consumer's job; the kit ships no font binary and requests no network. The guideline's 14px base and 2-10px spacing scale were rejected as too cramped; the 1rem body and the rem-stepped space scale above are the recorded deviations (D-2).

onPrimary.$description: Text drawn on the primary fill. The dark theme re-points primary at a light shade, where white would measure 1.8:1, so the label colour has to be a token and not a constant.

border.$description: Control and container edges that identify a boundary. One primitive cannot serve both modes: slate.300 measures 1.48:1 on the light surface and slate.500 measures 2.18:1 on the dark surface.

focusRing.$description: :focus-visible indicator, never hidden (adopted brand rule). The documented citation name is --color-focus-ring (color.focusRing bridge), which resolves through this token and follows the dark-theme override. Contrast audit (ui-design-guideline-adoption): 6.41:1 on the light background, 12.56:1 on the dark background, against the 3:1 non-text floor of WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11. The legacy emitted name --focus-ring is baselined and stays.

theme.$description: Theme override map. Not a token group: each value is an alias to a declared primitive, keyed by the semantic color token it re-points in that mode. The generator holds no token names and no values for a mode, so a dark theme is as themeable as a light one (design.md D-B).
